goal: Preserve every distinct failed file in the job log when multiple raw filenames collapse to the same lossy display path, without repeating a failure already recorded live.
recommended_approach: Track recorded failures by composite display-path and raw-byte identity, reconcile each close-time summary failure independently against that set, and pin both completeness and deduplication with a focused regression test.
comparison: The change implements that approach directly: live failures retain composite identity, summary entries are considered individually with exact raw bytes when available, and the regression test verifies both the previously hidden failure and once-only logging. A mutation restoring the old path-bucket skip failed with one event instead of two; restoring the reviewed head passed, as did all run_log tests and formatting checks.
